```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install anthropic

      - name: Run Claude triage
        env:
          ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import os, json, anthropic
          issue_title = os.getenv("ISSUE_TITLE")
          issue_body = os.getenv("ISSUE_BODY")
          client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"))
          prompt = f"""You are an issue triage assistant. Analyze the following issue and suggest labels to apply. Output a JSON object with a key "labels" containing an array of label names. The issue title and body are:
          Title: {issue_title}
          Body: {issue_body}
          """
          response = client.completions.create(
              model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620",
              max_tokens=200,
              temperature=0,
              prompt=prompt,
          )
          output_text = response.completion.strip()
          try:
              data = json.loads(output_text)
          except json.JSONDecodeError:
              data = {"labels": []}
          labels = data.get("labels", [])
          with open("claude_output.json", "w") as f:
              json.dump({"labels": labels}, f)
          PY

      - name: Parse labels
        id: parse
        run: |
          labels=$(jq -r '.labels | join(",")' claude_output.json)
          echo "labels=$labels" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Apply labels
        uses: peter-evans/label@v5
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          labels: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.labels }}
```
